kai: Heads-up — weird "chunk wobble" in the browser SDK stream path. Under a choppy mobile link the trailing punctuation sometimes logs before a mid-stream sentence. No socket error shown; UI just jumps. :confused:
fran: which transport? EventSource or fetch+streams? any quick logs?
kai: EventSource (our wrapper). Tiny log sample:
[07:30:01] seq=1 text=\"Hey\"
[07:30:04] seq=5 text=\".\"   <-- final period arrives early
[07:30:07] seq=2 text=\", nice\"
[07:30:08] seq=3 text=\" to meet\"
[07:30:09] seq=4 text=\" you\"
No reconnect popups in devtools.
dave: sounds like two possible culprits: (1) proxy/runtime partial flush ordering under HTTP/2 when frames split, or (2) client opens a new connection during an auth refresh and the runtime replays buffered fragments, which can interleave. Do you see auth refresh logs around 07:30:03?
kai: yes token refresh shows at 07:30:03. We use short-lived tokens for dev builds.
fran: quick mitigation: toggle `autoReconnect:false` in the SDK or bump reconnect delay — stops overlap-based replays. But that's not ideal long-term.
abby: ops suggestion: runtime should add a small per-flush header like `X-Stream-Session` and a monotonic `X-Chunk-Seq` (or set SSE `id:`). That gives clients a stable ordering key. SDKs can then reorder/dedupe deterministically across reconnects.
dave: agree. On client side we should: buffer incomplete SSE events (handle CRLF split boundaries), expose `reorderOnChunkSeq:true` behind a feature flag, and emit a diagnostic metric `sdk.streams.ofo_count` (out-of-order count) when we fix up ordering.
kai: i can reproduce locally with nghttp2 + tc netem: throttle to 90kbps, force H2 DATA splits, then trigger a token refresh at 2.5s. I'll add a tiny script in sampleapp/scripts/repro that automates it.
fran: nice. QA ask: include a failing e2e that asserts assembled text equals seq 1..N. Put it under sampleapp/ci/stream-reorder.spec so this doesn't regress. Also please add a minimal unit that simulates CRLF split inside an SSE event.
abby: runtime owners: can we include `X-Chunk-Seq` in the next canary? Even a short-term header lets SDKs be conservative while we design more robust resume tokens.
dave: infra note: we'll add a trace annotation when buffered replay happens so we can correlate `stream-session` + seqs in tracing. That'll make postmortems easier.
devx-bot: created ticket #6483 "browser-sdk: support reorderOnChunkSeq + buffer incomplete SSE events; add sampleapp repro and telemetry" https://git.redwood/infra/issues/6483 :robot_face:
kai: i'll draft the SDK patch behind a feature flag and upload the sampleapp repro script. Will link PR to #6483. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
